## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; rotation into Energy and cyclicals but leadership is concentrated. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy in Top 5); confirmations: broad sector-level positivity and heavy concentration in Energy, while megacap divergence (MSFT/AMZN/TSLA) tempers conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND; Financials steady: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, CL (sentiment weak) showing pressure. Consumer Discretionary soft: HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION. Materials underperforming on balance: FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy) — concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND. Note Major Divergence across megacaps: MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -12.48%) RECOVERY — tactical caution advised.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Internal Rotation; Tech breadth: 14/24 positive. Mixed trends — NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND offset by AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Steady/rotational; Financials breadth: 13/20 positive. JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND show resilience while V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY signals mixed internals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Moderate strength; Healthcare breadth: 10/17 positive. JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND contrast with UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Financials given narrow but strong Energy leadership (MPC/CVX/XOM) and steady Financials (JPM/MA); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing trend exhaustion (AAPL, AMZN, MSFT) and monitor AMAT where news and price diverge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Energy breadth: 9/10 positive) on outsized weekly gains. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (Consumer Stpl. breadth: 3/14 positive) and parts of Consumer Discretionary where weakness is concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 1,000 area as short-term resistance for ABOVE TREND continuation (price action dependent); AAPL 160 area as key support for BELOW TREND stabilization; CVX 190 breakout would signal continued Energy leadership; JPM 165 as level to confirm ABOVE TREND follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MPC (+60): Marathon Q2 surge; MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed (accumulation). AMAT (+60): Record Q3 AI results; AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — sentiment versus price diverging, watch for follow-through. GOOGL (+55): Berkshire stake boost; GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet reflected in price. BA (+70): 737-7 FAA news; BA (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION — positive news amid short-term pullback.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-50): Fair-value cuts on AI margin concerns; META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. HD (-50): Macro/earnings caution; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. CSCO (-45): AI hardware margin squeeze headlines; CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — price weakening confirms news.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Energy leads while breadth is positive but leadership is narrow. MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence and concentrated Energy leadership plus news/price disconnects (AMAT bullish news but price BELOW TREND) — watch for trend breaks.
